ARC1833I.pattern: ^WITHDRAW COMPLETED FOR COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*BACKUP VERSION NUMBER (?<version>\d+) WAS (?<withdraw_result>UNCHANGED|INVALIDATED)

ARC1834I.description: Withdraw relacji incremental FlashCopy - wersja nadal odtwarzalna
ARC1834I.pattern: ^INCREMENTAL FLASHCOPY RELATIONSHIPS WITHDRAWN FOR COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*VERSION NUMBER (?<version>\d+)

ARC1835I.description: Brak waznych wersji backupu copy poola
ARC1835I.pattern: ^NO VALID BACKUP VERSIONS EXIST FOR COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>\S+)

ARC1819I.description: Withdraw nieudany - relacja FlashCopy zostala (alert krytyczny)
ARC1819I.pattern: ^WITHDRAW PROCESSING FAILED FOR SOURCE DEVICE <?(?<src_devn>[0-9A-F]+)>? AND TARGET DEVICE <?(?<tgt_devn>[0-9A-F]+)>?,\s*RC=\s*(?<sdm_rc>\d+),\s*REAS=\s*(?<sdm_reas>\d+)

ARC1838I.description: Reinicjalizacja wolumenu po withdraw (RC=12 - VTOC moze byc nieuzywalny)
ARC1838I.pattern: ^INITIALIZATION ATTEMPT OF COPY POOL BACKUP STORAGE GROUP VOLUME (?<volser>\S+) HAS COMPLETED,\s*RC=\s*(?<reinit_rc>\d+),\s*RSN\s*=\s*(?<rsn>\d+)

ARC1849I.pattern: ^REVERSE RESTORE FAILED FROM VOLUME (?<frb_volser>\S+) TO VOLUME (?<src_volser>[^,\s]+),\s*RC=\s*(?<rc>\d+)

ARC1850I.description: Wolumen z wieloma targetami FlashCopy (lista w liniach CONT.)
ARC1850I.pattern: ^VOLUME (?<volser>\S+) IN COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>\S+) HAS MULTIPLE FLASHCOPY TARGETS, AS FOLLOWS(?:\s+(?<fc_targets>.*))?

ARC1851I.pattern: ^BACKUP VERSION (?<invalidated_version>\d+) FOR COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+) WAS INVALIDATED,\s*RC=\s*(?<rc>\d+)

ARC1870I.description: Message data set FR utworzony (.I = w toku)
ARC1870I.pattern: ^MESSAGE DATA SET (?<msg_dsn>\S+) CREATED FOR (?:FAST REPLICATION )?(?<fr_function>.+?) OF (?:COPY POOL|VOLUME) (?<copy_pool>\S+)

ARC0640I.description: Komunikaty DFSMSdss (ADRnnnn) przekazane przez HSM; linie bez ADR pomijane
